aim: Generate cinematic scene images for the Ledras Lament narrative using fal.ai FLUX Control LoRA Canny, driven by a Canny edge map of a fixed amphitheater stage guide.

settings.imagine-config.json: Runtime config: model, resolution, control_lora_image_url (stage guide), seed, scene file path.
settings.gateway.json: Token budget for fal.ai API calls. Deducted per generation. Resets to 1 on manual edit.

stage/.aim: Guide images for Canny edge conditioning — the architectural invariant that all generations conform to.

2do/.aim: Persistent task management and project workflow tracking.
key: README.md — Comprehensive project task overview and status reporting.
task_log.json — Machine-readable task tracking and dependency management.
reports/ — Historical task execution reports and evidence collection.

data/sources/.aim: Canonical scene definitions and favorites registry.
key: ledras_scenes_v10_rehersal_1.json — Main rehearsal scene definitions with empty center tiers and reduced vertical walls.
fav_prompts.json — Lightweight favorite prompts overlay linked by request_id and subscene_id

tests/.key: test_fal_generate.py — 14 assertions: resolution mapping, cost est, prompt building, schema compliance, subscene prompts, filename format.

key: generation_log.jsonl — append-only URL log for failed-download recovery

recyclebin/.aim: Archived legacy files. No active code depends on these.

docs/.aim: Reference docs, context, production notes. Not consumed by code.

root_files: fal_generate.py — Main generator. LedrasConfig + LedrasSceneGenerator. CLI: `python3 fal_generate.py [scene_ids]`; `--subscenes` for narrative subscene generation.
README.md — Project documentation, config model, quick start.
imagine-config.json — Sole config source (see settings above).
